ja345:1.1: Vanaṃ yad' aggi dahati pāvako kaṇhavattanī kathaṃ karosi pacalaka evaṃ dandhaparakkamo ti.
ja345:2.1: Bahūni rukkhacchiddāni pathavyā vivarāni ca, tāni ce nābhisambhoma hoti no kālapariyāyo ti.
ja345:3.1: Yo dandhakāle tarati taraṇīye ca dandhati sukkhapaṇṇaṃ va akkamma atthaṃ bhañjati attano.
ja345:4.1: Yo dandhakāle dandhati taraṇīye ca tārayi sasīva rattiṃ vibhajaṃ tass' attho paripūratīti.
